title: Decode String
constraints: Input encoding is valid; repeat counts lie in [1,300].
The decoded output has at most 10^5 characters.
Digits appear only as repeat counts immediately before [. Literal text consists of lowercase English letters.

examples.explanation: First decode 2[c] as cc, then repeat acc three times.

inputFormat: Implement decodeString(s), where s is a valid encoding using lowercase letters, positive integer repeat counts, and square brackets.
outputFormat: The fully expanded string, preserving the order of literal text and repeated groups.
